title: Diffusions with Critical Divergence-Free Drifts: Varadhan Asymptotics and Path-Law Singularity
summary: We study the Euclidean Varadhan formula (EVF) and path laws for diffusions with critical divergence-free drifts in dimension $d\geq2$. For drifts given by smooth bounded skew-symmetric stream matrices, we prove a quantitative lower bound under a sector condition with a lower-order term. Its constants depend only on the dimension and the sector condition data. By approximation, the locally uniform Euclidean lower bound holds for all divergence-free $L^\infty_t{\rm BMO}^{-1}_x$ drifts.
